sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS PORTIONS CENTRAL PLAINS
sections.text: ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS PORTIONS SRN/WRN MT AND SMALL ADJACENT PART OF ID...

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: UPPER-AIR PATTERN WILL CONTINUE TO BE CHARACTERIZED BY SYNOPTIC TROUGHING OVER ERN CONUS...CONNECTED TO QUASISTATIONARY HUDSON BAY VORTEX. HOWEVER...RIDGING NOW OVER ROCKY MTN STATES WILL DEAMPLIFY...AS CYCLONE NOW OFFSHORE PAC NW MOVES INLAND. ASSOCIATED SHORTWAVE TROUGH -- NOW EVIDENT IN MOISTURE CHANNEL IMAGERY OVER COASTAL NRN CA NEAR CAPE MENDOCINO -- IS FCST TO PIVOT NEWD TO NRN ROCKIES NEAR ID/MT BORDER BY 2/00Z. PART OF ITS VORTICITY FIELD SHOULD SPLIT EWD ACROSS MT OVERNIGHT. BROAD BELT OF RELATIVELY MAXIMIZED/MID-UPPER LEVEL NWLYS WILL PERSIST FROM CANADIAN PRAIRIES SEWD ACROSS MID-UPPER MS VALLEY TO OH VALLEY...WITH SLOW EWD SHIFT OF EMBEDDED SPEED MAX AND FOREGOING TROUGHING ACROSS GREAT LAKES. AS THIS OCCURS...HEIGHT FALLS ALOFT WILL OVERSPREAD MUCH OF CENTRAL/NRN APPALACHIANS...MID-ATLC REGION AND NEW ENGLAND. AT SFC...PRESSURE FALLS ARE EXPECTED WITH INTENSIFICATION OF LEE TROUGH ACROSS CENTRAL/NRN HIGH PLAINS...AND CYCLOGENESIS IN SERN WY/NERN CO REGION BY 2/00Z. AT THAT TIME...WARM FRONT SHOULD EXTEND EWD FROM LOW ACROSS SRN NEB...WITH SEPARATE FRONTAL ZONE FROM NRN MN SWWD ACROSS ERN/SRN SD AND NERN WY. LEE TROUGH SHOULD EXTEND FROM LOW SWD ACROSS E-CENTRAL/SERN C

sections.title: CENTRAL PLAINS REGION
sections.text: SCATTERED TSTMS SHOULD DEVELOP ESPECIALLY OVER WRN PARTS OF OUTLOOK AREA MID-LATE AFTN...WHERE HEATING OF HIGHER ELEVATIONS WILL BE NEAR CONVERGENCE ASSOCIATED WITH LEE TROUGH. ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED TSTMS ALSO ARE POSSIBLE FARTHER E ACROSS SANDHILLS INTO CENTRAL NEB. MOST SUPPORTIVE BOUNDARY-LAYER AIR MASS WILL EXIST E OF LEE TROUGH AND BETWEEN FRONTAL ZONES...IN CORRIDOR FROM BLACK HILLS AND NEARBY PORTIONS WY/NEB BORDER ESEWD ACROSS CENTRAL/NRN NEB. 60S F SFC DEW POINTS SHOULD BE COMMON ACROSS THIS CORRIDOR...WITH PATCHY/EVAPOTRANSPIRATIVELY BOOSTED VALUES NEAR 70 F POSSIBLE OVER CENTRAL/ERN NEB...SUPPORTING PEAK AFTN MLCAPE 2000-3000 J/KG. BACKED WINDS N OF SRN FRONT WILL CONTRIBUTE TO ENLARGED LOW-LEVEL HODOGRAPHS...WITH 0-1 KM SRH VALUES POSSIBLY IN 200-300 J/KG RANGE...AND 45-55 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR MAGNITUDES. AS SUCH...SUPERCELLS WITH DAMAGING HAIL AND SVR GUSTS ARE POSSIBLE. EVOLUTION INTO MCS SHOULD ENHANCE DAMAGING-WIND POTENTIAL AS ACTIVITY SHIFTS EWD TO ESEWD ACROSS OUTLOOK AREA THIS EVENING. GRADUAL NOCTURNAL STABILIZATION OF FOREGOING BOUNDARY LAYER SHOULD MITIGATE WIND THREAT WITH TIME OVERNIGHT.

sections.title: NRN ROCKIES
sections.text: BY MID-LATE AFTN...EXPECT DIABATIC HEATING OF HIGHER TERRAIN...CONCURRENT WITH STRENGTHENING OF BOTH DEEP SHEAR AND LARGE-SCALE ASCENT/DCVA ALOFT PRECEDING EJECTING MIDLEVEL WAVE. LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE ALSO SHOULD BE RELATIVELY MAXIMIZED INVOF SFC TROUGH EXTENDING NWWD FROM NRN WY. RESULT SHOULD BE SCATTERED TSTMS DEVELOPING THIS AFTN...IN ENVIRONMENT OF ELONGATED HODOGRAPHS AND STG LOW-MIDDLE LEVEL SPEED SHEAR. SUPERCELL AND BOWING STORM MODES EACH APPEAR POSSIBLE...WITH SVR HAIL AND DAMAGING GUSTS EXPECTED FROM MOST PERSISTENTLY ORGANIZED ACTIVITY. WELL-MIXED SUBCLOUD LAYERS ARE EXPECTED...ESPECIALLY ALONG SRN/SERN RIM OF CONVECTIVE PLUME WHERE SFC HEATING WILL BE MOST PERSISTENT...LEADING TO MAINTENANCE OF DOWNDRAFT GUSTS AND HAIL GENERATED ALOFT.

sections.title: ERN SEABOARD STATES
sections.text: BAND OF SCATTERED TO LOCALLY NUMEROUS TSTMS SHOULD DEVELOP FROM MIDDAY THROUGH EARLY EVENING INVOF FRONT AND PREFRONTAL TROUGH...POTENTIALLY BACKBUILDING AS FAR SW AS MS DELTA REGION. MAIN CONCERN SHOULD BE ISOLATED DAMAGING GUSTS...RELATED TO DOWNDRAFT PRECIP LOADING. FOREGOING AIR MASS WILL BE VERY MOIST WITH SFC DEW POINTS COMMONLY 70S F FROM MID-ATLC SWD AND 60S FARTHER N. INSOLATION OF THIS AIR MASS WILL OFFSET MEAGER MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES ENOUGH TO BOOST PRECONVECTIVE MLCAPE INTO 2000-2500 J/KG RANGE OVER MUCH OF DIXIE...AND 1000-1500 J/KG IN PARTS OF MID-ATLC REGION. AS NOTED ABOVE...STRONGEST FLOW ALOFT WILL REMAIN ON BACK SIDE OF TROUGH. THIS WILL LEAD TO RATHER MODEST DEEP SHEAR -- E.G. 20-30 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR MAGNITUDES OVER MUCH OF PREFRONTAL SECTOR. MESSY CONVECTIVE MODE ALSO IS LIKELY OVER MUCH OF THIS CORRIDOR. HOWEVER...STRENGTHENING ISALLOBARIC FORCING AND RELATED INCREASE IN LOW-LEVEL FLOW WILL LEAD TO ENLARGEMENT OF LOW-LEVEL HODOGRAPHS FROM PORTIONS CAROLINAS INTO SERN NY...CONCURRENT WITH DIABATIC SFC WARMING AND WEAKENING MLCINH. WITH RELATED 0-1 KM SRH VALUES 100-200 J/KG AND LOW LCL...CONDITIONAL TORNADO THREAT CANNOT BE RULED OUT. ..EDWARDS/ROGERS.. 08/01/2

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER PARTS OF MT/ID
sections.text: ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS ACROSS THE CENTRAL AND NORTHERN HIGH PLAINS... AN EXPANSIVE UPPER RIDGE IS PRESENT TODAY OVER THE ROCKIES AND SOUTHWEST STATES...WHILE BROAD CYCLONIC FLOW IS MAINTAINED OVER THE NORTHEAST. DESPITE RATHER WEAK FORCING...SEVERAL PLACES WILL SEE A RISK OF ISOLATED TO SCATTERED STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS.

sections.title: NORTHERN PLAINS
sections.text: A CLUSTER OF THUNDERSTORMS IS ONGOING THIS MORNING OVER NORTHERN NEB. THIS ACTIVITY APPEARS TO BE TIED TO LOW LEVEL WARM ADVECTION...AND MAY PERSIST FOR SEVERAL HOURS WHILE IT TRACKS SOUTHWARD TOWARD THE KS/NEB BORDER. THE STRONGEST STORMS COULD PRODUCE GUSTY WINDS OR HAIL...BUT ORGANIZED SEVERE STORMS ARE NOT CURRENTLY ANTICIPATED. ANOTHER ROUND OF CONVECTION IS EXPECTED TO DEVELOP BY LATE AFTERNOON OVER EASTERN WY AND WESTERN SD/NEB. LARGE SCALE FORCING WILL BE WEAK LATER TODAY...BUT MODEL SOUNDINGS SHOW SUFFICIENT WESTERLY FLOW ALOFT AND STRONG CAPE TO PRODUCE LOCALLY SEVERE STORMS CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. STORMS MAY PERSIST DEEP INTO THE EVENING WITH BOW STRUCTURES POSSIBLY TRACKING SOUTHEASTWARD ACROSS NEB.

sections.title: MT/ID
sections.text: A WELL-DEFINED SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER NORTHERN CA WILL ROTATE NORTHEASTWARD INTO MT/ID BY EVENING. GUIDANCE IS IN STRONG AGREEMENT THAT SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS WILL DEVELOP LATER THIS AFTERNOON OVER HIGHER ELEVATIONS AND SPREAD EASTWARD ACROSS THE SLIGHT RISK AREA. RATHER DEEP EASTERLY LOW LEVEL WINDS AND DEWPOINTS NEAR 50F MAY BE SUFFICIENT FOR A FEW ROTATING/SEVERE STORMS CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL.

sections.title: MID ATLANTIC REGION
sections.text: A MID LEVEL SHORTWAVE TROUGH IS MOVING EASTWARD ACROSS THE EASTERN UNITED STATES...WITH THE TROUGH AXIS EXTENDING ROUGHLY FROM WESTERN PA INTO EASTERN KY/TN. RATHER STRONG SOUTHERLY LOW LEVEL WINDS AHEAD OF THE TROUGH...COUPLED WITH AMPLE PWAT VALUES AND DEWPOINTS WELL INTO THE 60S SUGGEST SOME POTENTIAL FOR THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT. FORECAST HODOGRAPHS INDICATE THAT LOW LEVEL SHEAR WILL BE SUFFICIENT FOR TRANSIENT ROTATION IN THE STRONGEST CELLS. ..HART/MARSH.. 08/01/2013

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: THE LARGE-SCALE PATTERN WILL CHANGE LITTLE THROUGH THE D1 PERIOD WITH A LONG-WAVE TROUGH FROM HUDSON BAY TO THE SRN ATLANTIC COAST...AN UPPER-LEVEL LOW OVER THE PACIFIC NW...AND A GRADUALLY DAMPENING RIDGE CENTERED ACROSS THE SRN HIGH PLAINS. ONE POTENTIALLY SALIENT FEATURE TO CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT IS A SHORT-WAVE TROUGH WHICH WILL TRANSLATE FROM THE BASE OF PACIFIC NW UPPER LOW NEWD INTO THE NRN ROCKIES. IN THE LOW LEVELS...A WAVY QUASI-STATIONARY BOUNDARY EXTENDING FROM A LEE CYCLONE OVER WRN MT SEWD THROUGH THE MID MO VALLEY MAY INTENSIFY WHILE SLOWLY DEVELOPING NWD. ELSEWHERE...A COLD FRONT FROM THE UPPER OH VALLEY TO SRN APPALACHIANS WILL PROGRESS EWD TOWARD THE ATLANTIC COAST. ...NRN HIGH PLAINS INTO THE MID MO VALLEY THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT... MULTIPLE CLUSTERS OF ELEVATED TSTMS ARE ONGOING FROM THE BLACK HILLS SWD/SEWD ACROSS NEB WITH ACTIVITY LARGELY BEING FORCED BY A DIURNALLY WEAKENING LOW-LEVEL WIND MAXIMUM. LATEST MODEL GUIDANCE SUGGESTS THAT A SUBSET OF THESE STORMS MAY PERSIST TODAY --LIKELY INTENSIFYING AND BECOMING SURFACE BASED-- AS THE LOW-LEVEL JET RE-INTENSIFIES OWING TO THE COUPLING WITH THE RIGHT ENTRANCE REGION OF AN UPPER-LEVEL JET STREAK ACROSS THE UP

sections.title: NRN ROCKIES THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING
sections.text: FORCING FOR ASCENT/DCVA ATTENDANT TO THE SHORT-WAVE TROUGH PIVOTING AROUND THE PARENT UPPER-LEVEL LOW WILL AUGMENT TERRAIN-ENHANCED CIRCULATIONS TO FOSTER SCATTERED TSTMS THIS AFTERNOON. WHILE THE ENVIRONMENT IS NOT OVERLY MOIST...THE PRESENCE OF STEEP LAPSE RATES AND AMPLE DEEP-LAYER SHEAR WILL SUPPORT THE DEVELOPMENT OF HIGH-BASED SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL WITH THIS THREAT SPREADING EWD/NEWD INTO THE HIGH PLAINS OF CNTRL MT THIS EVENING.

sections.title: NORTHEAST/MID ATLANTIC STATES THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING
sections.text: FORCING FOR ASCENT/DCVA WILL INCREASE ACROSS THE REGION TODAY IN RESPONSE TO THE ENEWD PROGRESSION OF A SHORT-WAVE TROUGH ACROSS THE LOWER GREAT LAKES. WHEN COUPLED WITH LOW-LEVEL UPLIFT ALONG THE COLD FRONT...EXPECT AN INCREASE IN STORM COVERAGE THIS AFTERNOON. BREAKS IN THE CLOUDS MAY ALLOW FOR CORRIDORS OF GREATER DESTABILIZATION AND THE POTENTIAL FOR LOCALLY STRONG TO SEVERE STORM DEVELOPMENT WITH THE PRIMARY HAZARD BEING DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. HOWEVER...GENERALLY WEAK VERTICAL SHEAR AND FAIRLY WIDESPREAD CLOUDS ARE EXPECTED TO LIMIT MORE ORGANIZED SEVERE WEATHER POTENTIAL. ..MEAD/SMITH.. 08/01/2013

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: UPPER-AIR PATTERN WILL BE DOMINATED BY RIDGING ACROSS ERN TIER OF STATES...AND TWO PRIMARY CYCLONES... 1. HUDSON BAY VORTEX...S OF WHICH NW FLOW WILL PREVAIL FROM MB SEWD ACROSS UPPER MS VALLEY...UPPER GREAT LAKES AND OH VALLEY REGION. SHORTWAVE TROUGH -- NOW EVIDENT IN MOISTURE CHANNEL IMAGERY OVER LH AND OH -- LIES WITHIN LARGER-SCALE TROUGH ATTM. THIS PERTURBATION IS EXPECTED TO PIVOT EWD THEN NEWD ACROSS PORTIONS PA/NY THROUGH REMAINDER PERIOD. 2. BROAD VORTEX CENTERED INVOF AST...AND FCST TO MOVE SLOWLY NEWD ACROSS COASTAL PAC NW AND CASCADES THROUGH REMAINDER PERIOD. SHORTWAVE TROUGHS/VORTICITY MAXIMA PRECEDING THAT CYCLONE WERE EVIDENT OVER NRN ID AND NERN ORE. THESE FEATURES WILL MOVE NEWD ACROSS NRN ROCKIES THROUGH REMAINDER PERIOD...LOSING IDENTITY AMIDST STRONGLY DIFLUENT UPPER FLOW AND CONVECTIVELY PRODUCED MESOSCALE PERTURBATIONS. SERN EXTENSION OF ORE TROUGH -- INITIALLY OVER NRN NV/SWRN ID -- MAY STAY BETTER DEFINED AND MOVE ACROSS SWRN/CENTRAL MT BY END OF PERIOD. ON 23Z SFC CHART...WEAKENING COLD FRONT WAS DRAWN FROM SRN QUE SSWWD ALONG VA/CAROLINAS PIEDMONT TO SRN PORTIONS MS/AL. THIS BOUNDARY WILL MOVE EWD OVER NY AND WRN/CENTRAL NEW ENGLAND THROUGH REMAINDER PER

sections.title: CENTRAL PLAINS
sections.text: SEVERAL AREAS OF STG-SVR TSTMS ARE EVIDENT ATTM..INCLUDING QUASI-LINEAR MULTICELLULAR BAND BETWEEN OMA-GRI...MOVING SEWD TOWARD SERN NEB AND NERN KS. OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM THAT ACTIVITY EXTENDED WNWWD INTO NEB SANDHILLS...NEAR PERSISTENT SUPERCELL ABOUT 65 NNW LBF. WIDELY SCATTERED TSTMS...INCLUDING A FEW SUPERCELLS...WERE EVIDENT WNWWD OVER NEB PANHANDLE...WITH ISOLATED/POTENTIALLY SVR TSTM MOVING OFF BIGHORN RANGE TOWARD NWRN PORTIONS WW 457. SEVERAL STG-SVR TSTMS ALSO WERE MOVING ESEWD TO SEWD ACROSS PORTIONS ERN CO AND WRN KS. LBF RAOB AND FCST SOUNDINGS SUGGEST ENVIRONMENT OVER THIS AREA IS CHARACTERIZED BY PLUME OF RICH LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE AND STEEP LOW-MIDDLE LEVEL LAPSE RATES OVER MOST OF CENTRAL/SRN NEB AND PARTS OF NRN KS...WITH SWD DECREASE IN DEEP SHEAR. REF WWS 454...457...458...459...AND RELATED MESOSCALE DISCUSSIONS FOR LATEST NEAR-TERM INFO ON CONVECTION AND SVR POTENTIAL IN THIS REGION. TSTMS OVER CENTRAL NEB MAY AGGREGATE UPSCALE INTO SEWD-MOVING CLUSTER THIS EVENING AND OVERNIGHT...ALONG AND W OF OUTFLOW FROM ERN NEB CONVECTION...WITH CORRESPONDINGLY CONCENTRATED POTENTIAL FOR DAMAGING GUSTS. NW FLOW ALOFT...LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE NEAR BOUNDARY...STRENGTHENING SLY

sections.title: NRN ROCKIES AND ADJACENT BASINS AND HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: SCATTERED TSTMS WILL CONTINUE TO MOVE GENERALLY EWD OVER PORTIONS SRN/CENTRAL MT...INTO AIR MASS THAT IS AT LEAST MRGLLY BUOYANT...ATOP WELL-MIXED SUBCLOUD LAYERS THAT WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT STG-SVR GUST AND HAIL POTENTIAL FOR A FEW MORE HOURS. BACKED LOW-LEVEL WINDS EVIDENT IN VWP WILL ENHANCE STORM-RELATIVE INFLOW. REF WW 456 AND ACCOMPANYING MESOSCALE DISCUSSIONS FOR NOWCAST DEVELOPMENT OVER THIS REGION. MODIFIED MODEL SOUNDINGS SUGGEST DIABATIC SFC COOLING WILL DEEPEN NEAR-SFC STABLE LAYER ENOUGH TO REMOVE SFC-BASED BUOYANCY IN PRECONVECTIVE AIR MASS BY ABOUT 06Z. ..EDWARDS.. 08/02/2013

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ELEVATED TSTMS MAY PERSIST THIS MORNING WITH A RISK FOR MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL. A WATCH IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ELEVATED TSTMS HAVE RECENTLY DEVELOPED OVER SERN SD /E OF 9V9/ AND ACROSS PARTS OF N-CNTRL NEB /FROM NEAR ANW TO E OF BUB/ WITHIN A WEAK LOW-LEVEL WAA REGIME ATTENDANT TO A NOCTURNAL LOW-LEVEL WIND MAXIMUM. THIS FORCING MECHANISM IS EXPECTED TO SUSTAIN ONGOING STORMS THIS MORNING WITH FURTHER DEVELOPMENT POSSIBLE. 12Z OBSERVED SOUNDINGS INDICATE THAT THIS ACTIVITY IS ROOTED WITHIN A STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATE AND POTENTIALLY MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS THAT IS ALSO CHARACTERIZED BY MODESTLY STRONG CLOUD-BEARING SHEAR. AS SUCH...INTENSE/ROTATING UPDRAFTS ARE POSSIBLE WITH AN ATTENDANT RISK FOR HAIL. CURRENTLY...THE SEVERE WEATHER THREAT IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN ISOLATED AND MARGINAL IN NATURE AND A WATCH IS NOT ANTICIPATED. ..MEAD.. 08/01/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED TO SCATTERED SUPERCELLS WILL FORM BY MID-AFTERNOON WITH INITIAL PRIMARY RISKS OF VERY LARGE HAIL AND A FEW TORNADOES. A WW WILL BE ISSUED WITHIN THE HOUR...WITH MODERATE UNCERTAINTY OVER THE SPATIAL EXTENT OF AN INITIAL WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: 17Z SURFACE ANALYSIS PLACED A 1012 MB CYCLONE NEAR BFF...WITH A QUASI-STATIONARY FRONT EXTENDING NEWD AND THEN E ACROSS SRN SD. SURFACE-BASED CB/S HAVE FORMED ALONG THIS FRONT IN SHANNON/BENNETT COUNTIES SD. ADDITIONAL CU DEVELOPMENT HAS BEEN NOTED ALONG RESIDUAL OUTFLOW IN CNTRL NEB /CENTERED OVER VALLEY COUNTY/. ALTHOUGH LARGE-SCALE FOR ASCENT IS NEBULOUS...CONTINUED SURFACE HEATING WILL YIELD INCREASING DESTABILIZATION AND MINIMAL CAPPING WITH SUSTAINED SURFACE-BASED TSTMS EXPECTED DURING THE AFTERNOON /SUPPORTED BY RECENT HRRR RUNS/. STRONG DEEP-LAYER SHEAR AND STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL BE QUITE FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS PRODUCING LARGE HAIL /SOME SIGNIFICANT/. VEERING OF THE LOW-LEVEL WIND PROFILE ALONG WITH THE PRESENCE OF THE BOUNDARIES WILL SUPPORT A RISK FOR A COUPLE OF TORNADOES AS WELL.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLD POCKETS OF DMGG WINDS AND MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL MAY ACCOMPANY THE STRONGER STORMS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR MOSAIC SHOWS A CLUSTER OF STORMS OVER WRN NC AND SUBJECTIVE SURFACE ANALYSIS PLACES A COLD FRONT FROM THE VA PIEDMONT SWWD THROUGH PARTS OF WRN NC/SC. THE 12Z GSO RAOB WHEN MODIFIED FOR CURRENT SURFACE CONDITIONS FEATURING LOW 80S TEMPS AND LOW 70S DEWPOINTS...YIELDS AROUND 2000 J/KG MLCAPE. DESPITE A MODEST WLY WIND PROFILE...SOME LOOSE ORGANIZATION TO A MULTICELLULAR CLUSTER WILL PROBABLY CONTINUE. SPC EXPERIMENTAL HAIL GUIDANCE SUGGESTS A LOCALIZED THREAT FOR MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL WILL PROBABLY ACCOMPANY THE MOST INTENSE UPDRAFTS --OBJECTIVELY VALIDATED BY WDSS-II RADAR MESH WITHIN THE PAST HOUR AND A RECENT 1 INCH DIAMETER HAIL REPORT. ADDITIONALLY...RAIN-COOLED DOWNDRAFTS IN THE FORM OF WET/HYBRID MICROBURSTS...WILL PROVIDE A MECHANISM TO BRING POCKETS OF STRONG WINDS 40-50 MPH TO THE SURFACE /PERHAPS LOCALLY STRONGER/ THAT MAY RESULT IN A FEW INSTANCES OF WIND DAMAGE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED SEVERE STORM THREAT WILL LIKELY DEVELOP THIS AFTERNOON. A PROBABLE SUPERCELL RISK CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL/SEVERE WIND GUSTS WILL LIKELY PROMPT THE ISSUANCE OF A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH BY THE 1930-2100Z TIMEFRAME.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SUBJECTIVE SURFACE ANALYSIS AND SURFACE OBSERVATIONS SHOW TEMPS OVER SWRN MT GRADUALLY WARMING THROUGH THE 70S DEG F TO THE NORTH OF A WARM FRONT DRAPED EWD NEAR THE WY/MT BORDER FROM A SURFACE LOW OVER CNTRL ID. TO THE N OF THE FRONT...BACKED NELY LOW LEVEL FLOW IS WEAK AND LOW LEVEL MOISTURE WILL LIKELY CONTINUE TO MIX WITHIN A DEEPENING BOUNDARY LAYER AND RESULT IN SURFACE DEWPOINTS DROPPING THROUGH THE 40S. IN SPITE OF THIS...STEEP H7-H5 LAPSE RATES RANGING FROM 7-8 DEG C/KM WILL CONTRIBUTE TO AROUND 1000 J/KG MLCAPE AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER DESTABILIZES FURTHER. AS A MID-LEVEL VORTICITY MAXIMUM OVER NERN CA/NWRN NV/SERN OREGON CONTINUES TO ENCROACH UPON THE DISCUSSION AREA...ATTENDANT LARGE SCALE ASCENT AND STRONG MID-LEVEL SWLY FLOW FIELDS INCREASING WITH HEIGHT WILL FAVOR ORGANIZED STORMS. STORMS ARE FORECAST TO DEVELOP/MATURE THIS AFTERNOON AND MOVE AWAY FROM THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF NERN ID/SWRN MT INTO THE HIGH PLAINS. AN ISOLATED HAIL/SEVERE WIND GUST THREAT WILL BE HIGHEST WITH ANY SUPERCELL/S/ THAT DEVELOP.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: GREATEST NEAR-TERM SEVERE THREAT EXISTS IN THE FORM OF LARGE HAIL ACROSS ERN PORTION OF WW 454. MONITORING FOR POTENTIAL UPSTREAM DEVELOPMENT WITHIN AND W OF WW 454 WHERE AN ADDITIONAL WW ISSUANCE IS POSSIBLE BY 22-23Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MOST INTENSE SUPERCELL CLUSTERS CONTINUE TO GRADUALLY PROGRESS SEWD ACROSS PORTIONS OF NERN NEB ALONG THE BORDER OF WW/S 454/455. AIR MASS CONTINUES TO DESTABILIZE DOWNSTREAM OF THIS CLUSTER IN CNTRL/ERN NEB. MODERATE TO STRONG BUOYANCY AND VERY STRONG DEEP-LAYER SHEAR WILL SUPPORT LARGE HAIL PRODUCTION AND PERHAPS A TORNADO OR TWO. GIVEN THE CONGLOMERATION OF UPDRAFTS...AN INCREASE IN SEVERE WIND POTENTIAL CAN ALSO BE EXPECTED AS WELL. FARTHER W...INITIAL SUPERCELL CLUSTER INVOF VTN WHICH HAD A HISTORY OF REPORTED LARGE HAIL HAD CONSOLIDATED INTO A LONE CELL. WWD-SURGING OUTFLOW ASSOCIATED WITH THE EARLIER CLUSTER HAS MERGED WITH THE QUASI-STATIONARY FRONTAL ZONE...YIELDING INCREASINGLY AGITATED CU ALONG THE PINE RIDGE. CONVERGENCE ALONG THESE BOUNDARIES APPEARS TO BE STRENGTHENING GIVEN FAIRLY ROBUST WARM SECTOR PRESSURE FALLS AND ADDITIONAL SUPERCELL DEVELOPMENT SEEMS PLAUSIBLE BY 22Z. ..GRAMS.. 08/01/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SEVERE TSTM WATCH WILL BE ISSUED SOON FOR PORTIONS OF NORTHEAST CO/NORTHWEST KS/SOUTHWEST NEB. CONVECTIVE OUTLOOK WILL LIKELY BE AMENDED FOR A SLIGHT RISK UPGRADE ACROSS THE REGION...WITH DAMAGING WINDS/SEVERE HAIL AS THE PRIMARY HAZARDS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CLUSTERS OF STRONG/SEVERE STORMS CONTINUE TO MATURE/MOVE EASTWARD TO THE EAST OF THE I-25 CORRIDOR IN NORTHEAST CO...WHILE TOWERING CU/INCIPIENT TSTM DEVELOPMENT IS ALSO NOTED IN NORTHWEST KS. WHILE VERTICAL SHEAR IS NOT ROBUST...A RELATIVELY MOIST/UNSTABLE AIRMASS ACROSS NORTHEAST CO/SOUTHWEST NEB/NORTHWEST KS WITH 2000+ J/KG MLCAPE WILL ALLOW FOR THE SUSTENANCE/GRADUAL EAST-SOUTHEASTWARD PROPAGATION OF TSTM CLUSTERS THROUGH THE EVENING. DAMAGING WINDS AND SEVERE HAIL ARE THE PRIMARY HAZARDS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THREAT FOR DMGG WINDS AND LARGE HAIL WILL PERSIST ACROSS PORTIONS OF WW 456. A MORE LOCALIZED SVR THREAT MAY ALSO EXIST ACROSS N-CNTRL WY OVER THE NEXT FEW HRS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR TRENDS SHOW A SMALL BOWING SEGMENT ENTERING GALLATIN COUNTY...LIKELY EXHIBITING BOTH A DMGG WIND AND LARGE HAIL THREAT. THIS CLUSTER WAS CO-LOCATED WITH A RELATIVE MAXIMUM OF SFC PRESSURE FALLS...AND SHOULD CONTINUE TO PROGRESS E/NEWD ACROSS S-CNTRL MT. ADDITIONAL DISCRETE STORMS WERE ALSO NOTED S OF GTF...BUT THESE STORMS HAVE STRUGGLED TO PERSIST WITHIN A TIGHT INSTABILITY GRADIENT AND INVOF A SLIGHTLY COOLER BOUNDARY LAYER. GREATEST SHORT-TERM THREAT SHOULD PERSIST NEAR A BZN-BIL LINE...WHERE 10-20 KT ELYS ARE MAINTAINING UPPER 40S-LOWER 50S F DEWPOINTS AND GRADUAL DESTABILIZATION IS ONGOING. FARTHER S...ISOLATED TSTMS HAVE DEVELOPED W OF THE BIG HORNS AND CONTINUE TO PROGRESS EWD. ALTHOUGH THIS AREA IS FARTHER REMOVED FROM STRONGER FORCING FOR ASCENT...AND SLIGHTLY DRIER BOUNDARY LAYER CONDITIONS WERE OBSERVED...DEEP-LAYER SHEAR IS ADEQUATE TO SUPPORT A FEW SUPERCELLS THROUGH THE EARLY EVENING. ..ROGERS.. 08/01/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A WELL-ORGANIZED MCS WILL LIKELY TO POSE A SEVERE RISK THIS EVENING ACROSS EAST-CENTRAL/SOUTHEAST NEB...SUCH THAT A SEVERE TSTM WATCH WILL BE ISSUED SOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: QUASI-LINEAR MCS CONTINUES TO ORGANIZE/SHOW MODEST SIGNS OF ACCELERATION AS IT CONTINUES TO SPREAD SOUTH-SOUTHEASTWARD ACROSS EAST-CENTRAL NEB AS OF 23Z. A MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIRMASS CONTINUES TO FEED ESPECIALLY THE WESTERN FLANK OF THE MCS...WITH INCREASING /20+ KT/ OF STORM RELATIVE LOW-LEVEL INFLOW /REFERENCE HASTINGS AND OMAHA WSR-88D VWPS/ LIKELY TO SUPPORT SOME ADDITIONAL FORWARD PROPAGATION/SOUTH-SOUTHEASTWARD ACCELERATION OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE A CONCERN...WITH SEVERE HAIL ALSO POSSIBLE MAINLY ON ITS WESTERN FLANK.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TORNADO WATCH 454 CONTINUES UNTIL 03Z ACROSS NORTHERN/CENTRAL PORTIONS OF NEB...WITH AN ISOLATED TORNADO THREAT ASIDE FROM A MORE PREVALENT SEVERE HAIL/WIND RISK THROUGH MID-EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TO THE WEST OF AN EAST-CENTRAL NEB MCS /WITH SOME TORNADO AND HAIL-WIND POTENTIAL ON ITS WESTERN FLANK/...SHORT-TERM SEVERE RISK ACROSS TORNADO WATCH 454 EXISTS ACROSS NORTHWEST/NORTH-CENTRAL NEB AS OF 2330Z. AT LEAST SOME TORNADO POTENTIAL CONTINUES MAINLY WITH DUAL ONGOING SUPERCELLS ACROSS SOUTHERN PORTIONS OF SHERIDAN AND CHERRY COUNTIES...NEAR AN OUTFLOW REINFORCED FRONTAL BOUNDARY. WSR-88D VWP FROM NORTH PLATTE/THEDFORD NEB INDICATES AROUND 40 KT OF DEEP LAYER SHEAR...ALTHOUGH HIGHER MAGNITUDES /45-55 KT/ OF DEEP LAYER SHEAR LIKELY RESIDE ALONG THE NORTHERN NEB SURFACE BOUNDARY. WHILE LOW LEVEL SHEAR IS CURRENTLY MODEST...THE PRESENCE OF THE SURFACE BOUNDARY AND SOME EARLY EVENING INCREASE OF A SOUTHERN LOW LEVEL JET /PERHAPS A TREND ALREADY NOTED ACROSS FAR SOUTHERN NEB/ WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT SOME TORNADO RISK INTO MID-EVENING. OTHERWISE...THE AIRMASS REMAINS MODERATELY UNSTABLE /2000-2750 J PER KG MLCAPE/ ESPECIALLY ACROSS WEST-CENTRAL NEB. STORMS WILL LIKELY CONTINUE TO SPREAD GENERALLY SOUTHEASTWARD ACROSS WEST-CENTRAL/EAST-CENTRAL NEB WHILE POSING A LARGE HAIL/DAMAGING WIND RISK...WITH THE POSSIBILITY OF STORM MERGERS/UPSCALE GROWTH INTO AN MCS BY MID-EVENING...ASIDE FROM THE EAST-CENTRAL NEB MCS/RENEWED DEVELOPMENT ALONG OUTFLOW. ..GUYER.. 08/01/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE RISK FOR DMGG WINDS AND LARGE HAIL WILL CONTINUE ACROSS WW 457 AND 458 THROUGH AT LEAST MID-EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TSTM DEVELOPMENT WITHIN THE PAST COUPLE HRS HAS LARGELY BEEN FOCUSED ALONG TWO ANALYZED BOUNDARIES. ISOLATED SUPERCELLS WERE DEVELOPING OVER THE NEB PANHANDLE ALONG A COLD FRONT SLOWLY SAGGING SWD...WITH MORE RECENT TSTM DEVELOPMENT NOTED WWD INTO SERN WY. A N-S ORIENTED COMPOSITE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY/WIND SHIFT WAS MOVING EWD ACROSS THE SRN NEB PANHANDLE INTO NERN CO...WITH SCATTERED MULTICELL TO OCCASIONAL SUPERCELL STRUCTURES NOTED ON RECENT RADAR TRENDS. LATEST RAP/HRRR GUIDANCE SUGGESTS INCREASING LLJ SHOULD REMAIN FOCUSED E OF WW 457 AND NRN PORTIONS OF WW 458...WHICH MAY INHIBIT THE POTENTIAL FOR UPSCALE GROWTH THIS EVENING. HOWEVER...SUFFICIENT BUOYANCY EXISTS TO MAINTAIN ISOLATED SVR WIND/HAIL POTENTIAL FOR AT LEAST THE NEXT COUPLE HRS...BEFORE DIURNAL COOLING/DESTABILIZATION SHOULD FAVOR A GRADUAL WEAKENING TREND. ..ROGERS.. 08/02/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE TSTM WATCH 458 CONTINUES UNTIL 04Z...WITH A SEVERE WIND/HAIL THREAT CONTINUING ACROSS FAR NORTHEAST CO/NORTHWEST KS THROUGH MID-EVENING. PERHAPS A SPATIAL WFO EXTENSION ACROSS NORTHWEST KS ASIDE...A NEW WATCH ISSUANCE IS OTHERWISE NOT ANTICIPATED FOR WEST-CENTRAL/SOUTHWEST KS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STRONG/SEVERE TSTMS INCLUDING A FEW LOOSELY ORGANIZED CLUSTERS CONTINUE TO MOVE SLOWLY EASTWARD ACROSS WESTERN KS. GIVEN THAT THE AIRMASS REMAINS MODERATELY UNSTABLE /2000 J PER KG MLCAPE/ TO THEIR EAST...STORMS WILL LIKELY REMAIN CAPABLE OF SEVERE HAIL/WIND IN THE SHORT-TERM AS THEY CONTINUE TO PROPAGATE EAST-SOUTHEASTWARD IN AREAS ALONG/SOUTH OF I-70. THAT SAID...THE BOUNDARY LAYER WILL GRADUALLY COOL THE REMAINDER OF THE EVENING...SUCH THAT UPDRAFT INTENSITY/DOWNDRAFT POTENTIAL WILL GRADUALLY ABATE WITH A CORRESPONDING MARGINALITY OF THE HAIL/WIND POTENTIAL. ..GUYER.. 08/02/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TORNADO WATCH 454 CONTINUES UNTIL 03Z. SOME TORNADO POTENTIAL CONTINUES ACROSS WEST-CENTRAL/SOUTH-CENTRAL NEB...BUT THE PRIMARY RISK IS DAMAGING WINDS/SEVERE HAIL. GIVEN 03Z SCHEDULED EXPIRATION...A WATCH EXTENSION OF WW 459 AND/OR WW 457 WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED FOR SOUTH-CENTRAL/WEST-CENTRAL NEB.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A TREND TOWARD OF STORM CONSOLIDATION/MCS DEVELOPMENT IS READILY UNDERWAY CENTERED ALONG I-80 /AND 40-50 MILES EITHER SIDE NORTH-SOUTH/ ACROSS NEB...WITH THE MOST SCATTERED/SEMI-DISCRETE STORM MODE PERSISTING ACROSS SOUTH-CENTRAL NEB. ANY LINGERING TORNADO POTENTIAL IS LIKELY BE FOCUSED ACROSS IN AREAS ALONG I-80 ROUGHLY BETWEEN NORTH PLATTE/GRAND ISLAND...BUT ANY SUCH POTENTIAL SHOULD CONTINUE TO GRADUALLY ABATE OWING TO A COOLING BOUNDARY LAYER/CONGEALING STORM MODES INTO LATE EVENING. THE PRIMARY SCENARIO/RISK WILL LIKELY TO BE STORM MERGERS/SOUTHEASTWARD-MOVING MCS DEVELOPMENT WITH DAMAGING WINDS AND SOME SEVERE HAIL POTENTIAL. A 51 KT WIND GUST WAS RECENTLY MEASURED AT GRAND ISLAND. AT LEAST SOME SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE BEYOND 03Z...AND THUS A WATCH EXTENSION WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED WITHIN THE HOUR. ..GUYER.. 08/02/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE TSTM WATCHES 455/459 CONTINUE UNTIL 03Z AND 06Z RESPECTIVELY...WITH SEVERE TSTM WATCH 455 ALLOWED TO EXPIRE AT 03Z. DAMAGING WINDS/SOME SEVERE HAIL REMAINS A CONCERN...AND AT LEAST AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT COULD DEVELOP INTO FAR NORTHEAST KS AND EVENTUALLY INTO FAR NORTH-CENTRAL KS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LEADING EDGE OF A QUASI-LINEAR MCS CONTINUES TO SPREAD SOUTHEASTWARD TOWARD THE SOUTHEAST NEB/NORTHEAST KS BORDER...WITH ADDITIONAL STORMS CONTINUING TO REDEVELOP ON ITS WESTERN FLANK/COMPOSITE OUTFLOW ACROSS SOUTH-CENTRAL NEB. THE BOUNDARY LAYER CONTINUES TO GRADUALLY COOL SOUTH OF THE MCS...ALTHOUGH THE PRESENCE OF A SURFACE COOL POOL ACROSS SOUTHEAST/EAST-CENTRAL NEB SHOULD CONTINUE TO SUSTAIN STRONG/POTENTIALLY SEVERE-CALIBER LINEAR SEGMENTS/BOWS IN THE PRESENCE OF AN INCREASING SOUTHERLY LOW LEVEL JET/STORM RELATIVE INFLOW. DAMAGING WINDS WILL REMAIN A CONCERN INTO LATE EVENING ACROSS EXTREME SOUTH-CENTRAL/SOUTHEAST NEB AND POTENTIALLY NORTHEAST KS. WHILE NOT IMMINENT/CERTAIN...CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR SOME POSSIBILITY OF A SEVERE TSTM WATCH ACROSS NORTH-CENTRAL/NORTHEAST KS. ..GUYER.. 08/02/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: MERGING OUTFLOWS WILL SUPPORT CONTINUED SWD/SEWD MOVEMENT OF THE MCS IN SRN NEB AND NRN KS...WITH SOME RISK FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS OVERNIGHT. HOWEVER...THE MAGNITUDE AND COVERAGE OF THE SEVERE STORM RISK WILL BE MARGINAL FOR A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SEVERAL THUNDERSTORM CLUSTERS HAVE MERGED INTO AN EXTENSIVE MCS THAT IS MOVING SWD/SEWD FROM SRN NEB INTO N CENTRAL/NE KS. BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS IN THE MID-UPPER 60S AND LINGERING STEEP MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES ARE CONTRIBUTING TO A CORRIDOR OF WEAK-MODERATE BUOYANCY ACROSS NRN/CENTRAL KS. SUBSTANTIAL SLY STORM-RELATIVE INFLOW OF 30-40 KT AND MERGING STORMS/OUTFLOWS SHOULD SUPPORT CONTINUED SEWD MOTION OF THE MCS INTO KS. HOWEVER...THE BOUNDARY LAYER IS ALSO COOLING SLOWLY WITH TIME AND CONVECTIVE INHIBITION IS INCREASING. ALSO...PRIOR STORM BEHAVIOR AND THE ORIENTATION/MAGNITUDE OF THE LOW-MIDLEVEL WINDS DO NOT SUGGEST RAPID SEWD STORM MOTION. THESE FACTORS ARE NOT FAVORABLE FOR A MORE WIDESPREAD DAMAGING WIND RISK...THOUGH ISOLATED DAMAGING GUSTS CANNOT BE RULED OUT. THIS AREA WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR SEVERE STORM POTENTIAL INTO THE EARLY MORNING HOURS...THOUGH THE NEED FOR A WATCH IS NOT CLEAR. ..THOMPSON.. 08/02/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...
